description.value: You stir a primal awareness of mortality in one creature you can see within range, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for the duration (a target at 25 hit points or fewer makes this save with disadvantage). A frightened target may attempt this saving throw again at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Droids and constructs are unaffected.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 1
